title: sales.void — payload
description: Voids a COMPLETED sale (sales#26). The original stays immutable; the reason is mandatory (market rule: Toast, Lightspeed and Spanish fiscal software require it); a sale carrying a full invoice cannot be voided — issue a credit note instead. Second call on the same sale is refused (sales.already_voided) and emits nothing.

reason.description: Why the sale is voided: shown in the sales history and carried in sale.voided.
